SELECT account_id, region, group_avg, group_avg - overall_avg AS difference
FROM (
  SELECT account_id, region, group_avg,
         AVG(group_avg) OVER () AS overall_avg
  FROM (
    SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(o.amount) AS group_avg
    FROM "order" AS o
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE o.amount >= 2802
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
  )
)
WHERE group_avg > overall_avg
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
